svg.title: The Toolkit, step by step
svg.desc: Five molecules from the Core 00 catalog are followed through the Toolkit: one batch, a model with added physics, relaxation and dynamics, then reaction paths, enhanced sampling, training and domain decomposition. Hooks fire at every step; an agent can drive every step, and Toolkit-Ops kernels run underneath.

g.aria-label: a fast model for your task
Your agent drives every step with the published skills
